review-criteria:
  - id: F-01
    kind: validate
    criterion: "Ten columns in fixed order: Source Id / Source Kind / Source Name / Target Id / Target Kind / Target Name / S2T Relation / T2S Relation / Provenance / Observation"
    severity: HIGH
    why: "The graph renderer reads this table positionally; a reordered or missing column breaks it"
  - id: F-02
    kind: validate
    criterion: "Source Kind and Target Kind are members of a closed enum and agree with their id prefix"
    severity: HIGH
    why: "A kind that disagrees with its id prefix makes the node unresolvable on both readings"
  - id: F-03
    kind: validate
    criterion: "Every row carries a Provenance of declared, derived, or inferred"
    severity: MEDIUM
    why: "Provenance is how a reader tells an asserted edge from an inferred one"
  - id: F-04
    kind: validate
    criterion: "One row per relationship; both readings named on the same row"
    severity: MEDIUM
    why: "Splitting the two readings across rows double-counts the edge"
  - id: F-05
    kind: validate
    criterion: "A Coverage notes section follows the table on every run"
    severity: MEDIUM
    why: "Coverage is what distinguishes an empty result from an unrun extraction"

| fact-unanchored | citation markers skipped for want of an anchor string: 1698 | -- | -- |
